subject: Addendum & Exhibit integration — coverage/term clarifications
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Breen <john.breen@optix.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Addendum & Exhibit integration — coverage/term clarifications

Hi John,

Thanks again for the productive call earlier — excited to get Optix over the finish line. Attached is our proposed addendum (high level) and an updated Exhibit C that reflects the capacity uplift you outlined on the call. Two quick open points we want to resolve with you/your legal team before we circulate to Legal Ops: 

1) Term effective date for the addendum: you mentioned aligning to your fiscal start (7/1). We can set the addendum to become effective 7/1/2026, but legal needs to confirm that the renewal term language (MSA section 2.1) can reference the later effective date.
2) Billing/proration approach: OrderForm_v3 includes a monthly proration row for the July ramp — please confirm acceptance or propose your preferred proration mechanics.

I’ve CC’d Lauren (Legal) and Marissa (Customer Success) so they can weigh in on the few redline points we anticipate from your counsel (SLA effective date, data retention carveouts for test environments, and audit log access cadence).

Attachments: Optix_Renewal_Redlines_0614.docx (draft redlines), Exhibit-C-draft-0615.pdf (capacity table), OrderForm_v3_20260616.xlsx

Proposed next steps: if your team can review and get initial comments by end of week (6/18), we’ll consolidate and send a single tracked version back to you. If better, we can run a 30-min redline walk on Tuesday.

Thanks —
Dev
Dev Patel | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0206 | E: dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: John Breen <john.breen@optix.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@optix.ai
Date: 2026-06-15T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Addendum & Exhibit integration — coverage/term clarifications

Dev —

Thanks for the packet. A few items from our side after a quick pass:

- Our procurement prefers the addendum effective date to be 7/1/2026 — that works as long as there is clear language that the new capacity charges begin on that date and not retroactive.
- We’ve highlighted three clauses in the draft redlines: SLA credits window (we need 45 days), incident notification timeline (48 hours), and a short audit scope paragraph for SOC evidence.
- Attached a doc with inline comments (Optix_Renewal_Redlines_0614.docx).

We can do a 30-min call Tuesday 6/16 at 10am PT if that helps resolve quickly. Also, we’ll need the final order form by 6/25 to feed Finance for PO issuance.

—John
John Breen | Head of Infrastructure, Optix Analytics
john.breen@optix.ai | +1 (617) 222-3344

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, John Breen <john.breen@optix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Addendum & Exhibit integration — coverage/term clarifications

John / Dev —

Thanks for the notes, John. I reviewed the inline comments in Optix_Renewal_Redlines_0614.docx and pushed a couple of narrow edits that should address the SLA timing and audit scope while preserving Redwood’s standard protections. High-level responses below: 

- SLA credits: we can accept a 45-day cure and claim window (was 30 days). I added language to require documented mitigation steps during the window.
- Notification timeline: we can commit to initial notification within 48 hours for Sev1, with an operational update cadence (24/72 hours) depending on triage progress.
- Audit scope: we pushed back on broad forensic access and instead offered quarterly scoped evidence (SOC 2 reports, redacted logs) plus an on-site audit option with advance notice and cost allocation.

Two items I still need confirmation on from Optix: 
1) Whether you require any SLA measurement customizations for the uplifted GPUs (p99 latency carveouts for batch jobs). If yes, please provide examples so we can evaluate metric definitions.
2) Clarify the desired term roll (12 vs 24 months) in the addendum. The draft currently assumes a 12-month incremental addendum tied to the renewal, but we can set a 24-month term if you prefer pricing stability.

I attached a tracked PDF (Exhibit-C-draft-0615.pdf) showing the adjusted Exhibit language and a short redline summary.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Breen <john.breen@optix.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Addendum & Exhibit integration — coverage/term clarifications

John / Lauren / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turn. Short response and action items to keep momentum: 

- Dev note on term: John, can you confirm whether Optix would prefer the addendum to be a 12-month term (auto-terminate with renewal) or a 24-month committed term? Marissa, capturing this will impact onboarding timing and invoicing schedule.
- SLA metrics: John, if you can share two example batch queries or expected p99s for the heavy jobs, Lauren will draft the carveout language for Exhibit C.
- Doc circulation: I’ll consolidate Lauren’s track and your inline comments into one master redline and share a final for review by EOD Friday (6/18). Once we have signoff, I’ll send the DocuSign envelope (target: countersign by 6/25 so Finance can issue PO).

Link to working doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3COptixRenewal
DocuSign placeholder: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC-OPTIX-2026

Thanks —
Dev

From: John Breen <john.breen@optix.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@optix.ai, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T15:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Addendum & Exhibit integration — coverage/term clarifications

Dev / Team —

Confirming our responses: Optix prefers a 24-month committed term for the uplifted capacity (pricing locked) — this gives us predictability for budgeting. I’ll have procurement update the PO timeline to align with the 7/1 effective date and target countersign by 6/25.

Attached I’m sending a final set of redlines (same filename) with two tiny language tweaks on the audit paragraph; otherwise the edits from Lauren look good. Once you send the consolidated .docx with the tracked changes I’ll route to procurement and legal for signature.

Thanks for moving quickly — please let me know when the DocuSign is live and I’ll route the PO on our side.

—John

Optix_Renewal_Redlines_0614.docx (updated), OrderForm_v3_20260616.xlsx (accepted)
